newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BBL to choose new CEO next week.
newsitem.headline: BBL to choose new CEO next week.

text.p: The board of Belgian Banque Bruxelles Lambert (BBL) will choose a new chief executive officer on September 4, the bank said on Monday.
A BBL spokeswoman declined to comment on Belgian press reports that Michel Tilmant was the most likely successor to Daniel Cardon de Lichtbuer, who has held the post since December 1992.
Tilmant is a BBL board member, responsible for capital markets, corporate finance, investment management, market risk management, treasury, forex and insurance.
The new CEO will take up his post on January 1, she said.
On September 4, the board will also release first-half earnings.
